Used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the '''''Cord''-class starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] model equipped with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. A ''Cord''-class starfighter was stationed aboard the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]'' when the [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] following the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|Battle of Raxus Prime]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. After a battle, the starfighters were serviced by repair droids or the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] themselves.

==Characteristics==
The ''Cord''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model utilized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Fett" /> ''Cord''-class starfighters were armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and were often carried aboard the Republic's [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.9 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at least one ''Cord''-class starfighter was stationed aboard the Republic ''Acclamator''-class [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]'' while the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] following the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|planetside battle]]. When the refugee [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;who had masqueraded as an orphan named "Teff" to hide his identity from the Republic&mdash;was brought aboard the ''Candaserri'' soon after the battle, he witnessed a group of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] servicing the ''Cord''-class starfighter in one of the ''Candaserri''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Fett believed that a pair of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] servicing the starfighter might have been the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] [[4/619|CT-4/619]] and [[CT-5/501]], but he could not tell for certain due to the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] nearly identical [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Fett" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Cord''-class starfighter first appeared in the second installment of the [[Star Wars: Boba Fett (novel series)|''Boba Fett'']] young reader book series, [[Boba Fett: Crossfire|''Crossfire'']], written by [[Terry Bisson]] and released in [[2002]].<ref name="Fett" />
